OSTC-T11.detail: Survival by forward closure and survival by MinSup-disjointness agree on all 72,960 (hypergraph, revocation-set) cells, zero violations in either direction. Both outcomes occur: 19,380 survive and 53,580 die, so the criterion is discriminating rather than constant. Runner and checker compute the two sides by different means -- family-revocation intersection versus subset-of-surviving-tokens -- so agreement is not a shared implementation agreeing with itself.

OSTC-T10.detail: Composition retained every unresolved blocker across all 64 compositions, zero losses. This is the hypergraph setting; EXEC-CM-01 tested the same theorem on flat contract vectors, and the two do not share code.

repair.detail: Over 53,580 repair cells the cardinality heuristic never beat minimum-cost repair, and minimum-cost was strictly cheaper in 7,611. That second number is the one that matters: it shows the cost model is doing work rather than reducing to counting tokens. Had fewest-tokens always matched least-cost, reporting optimality would have overstated the finding.

comparator.detail: 72,960 agreements, 0 disagreements. T11's existence check does not require minimality, so a tie is the predicted outcome and a disagreement would have shown one of the two predicates wrong.

what_this_does_not_establish: Nothing beyond the declared grid: 6 tokens, 3 families of size 3. Total enumeration over a finite class, not a sample; no interval computed.
No proof-assistant correspondence; EXEC-PA-01 remains open.
No external adjudication. Runner and checker are two implementations inside one programme.
